neighbours.label: connecting/communicating with a remote machine: 'remote', 'to'/'with' after connect/request/communicate in networking (SSH, API, server) contexts
fire: The script opens an SSH session and copies the backup to the remote host.
This client sends each API request to the cloud server over HTTPS.
Use rsync to push the build directory onto the remote machine.
The daemon keeps a persistent connection with the database server in another region.
"""Open a channel connected to the remote shell and return it."""
Engineers can log in remotely and access files stored on the distant server.
The agent communicates with the central server every few seconds.
quiet: The script opens a local file and copies the backup to the second disk.
This client writes each log entry to the local disk in plain text.
Use cp to copy the build directory into the output folder.
The program keeps an open handle on the database file in the same folder.
"""Open a file in the current directory and return it."""
Engineers can sit at the desk and read files stored on the laptop.
The agent writes to a local log file every few seconds.

notes: Card: peaks on ' remote' (connected to the remote shell, remote_path), ' with' (session with an SSH server), ' to' (API request to Ravello), ' access' (access remote volumes). Logit effect of the - pole promotes remote/server/distant. Near misses keep code/docstring style but describe local operations.
